scope: Frozen hypothesis diagnostic before any new trade rule. No parameter search, no production or trading access.
source_protocol: guosheng_data_expansion_review_20261115/国盛新增分析数据源整改方案_R2交叉评审修订稿.md
source_amendments: guosheng_data_expansion_review_20261115/网页端第二轮修订条款原文.md
sampling: All original completed close-to-next-target-close intervals, latest completed end 2026-11-02. Keep monthly calendar grid and original targets. Quote-only window descriptive.

H1.reference_month: latest truly published by known-date China EOD, then check vintage; never choose older month to improve archive coverage
H1.target: compound metals minus compound 30-year bond total returns, excluding target-date return

H2.sign_rule: positive -> +1; zero or negative -> -1; missing -> unknown
H2.target: mean of individually compounded original selected assets minus mean of original unselected assets in frozen six-asset universe

model.rank: greedy fixed order normalized-column SVD, tolerance 1e-10, drop exact redundancy only; retain fixed original-model columns in bootstrap and mark rank failure
model.interpretation: conditional historical association; unknown source versions explicitly exploratory, not causal or tradable OOS

bootstrap.resample: full calendar grid, precomputed features and labels, retain eligibility; no redraw failed paths
bootstrap.name: 95% resampling percentile range, no guaranteed coverage; no p-values

year_assignment: target date, keep complete cross-year outcome; never crop at calendar year end

diagnostics.leave_event_out: H1 consecutive target months sharing sign(X1), missing breaks; H2 consecutive monthly grid eligible growth>0 and X2=1; event definition fixed before data
diagnostics.support: stage x current directions x carry, report overlap, residual X variance and rank; quote-only not multi-variable inferred

data_evidence.primary: official original monthly release values and dates where obtainable
data_evidence.vendor: current Tushare snapshot separately classified exploratory
data_evidence.source_time: China known-date EOD, date-only official page treated available at EOD
data_evidence.missing: do not fill, downgrade full feature dependency chain
data_evidence.if_no_release_record: no strict admission; exploratory assumed latest schedule explicitly separate
data_evidence.revision: first-release chain is not a complete latest-vintage PIT database

gate: If registered direction unsupported, weak support, or evidence too sparse, retain original strategy. No sign flip, winner stage, neighbor replacement or arbitrary trading overlay. Price-sharing may justify an explicit future rule card, never rename primary failure as success.
